stage: Fixed before discrete-profile availability calculations; extension of the existing compensated boundary, not a new estimator or universal DCE design law
coupling: Reuse each original uncentered Gaussian noise entry as the probability driver. Transform before within-menu centering. Retain the original signal, human choices, proxy categories, dimensions and powers exactly.
binary_transform: -1 below zero; +1 at or above zero
independent_interior_LP_selection: Every trial divisible by 50, every positive-power boundary/rank/unresolved state, and the 20 smallest positive interior margins across non-Gaussian variants
primary_gaussian_check: All 9000 classifications must reproduce the existing saved Gaussian states
uncertainty: Allocation Monte Carlo standard errors use the original 500 independent cohorts per budget; laws, dimensions and methods are paired variants, not independent samples
allowed_claim: Check finite-budget behavior under two independent symmetric discrete attribute laws against the same asymptotic boundary; retain every discrepancy and boundary state
excluded_claims: risk or confidence-interval validation for discrete profiles
global originality or journal acceptance certification
